might in some circumstances reuse the wrong connection for SMB(S)
transfers.

libcurl features a pool of recent connections so that subsequent requests can
reuse an existing connection to avoid overhead.

When reusing a connection a range of criteria must be met. Due to a logical
error in the code, a network transfer operation that was requested by an
application could wrongfully reuse an existing SMB connection to the same
server that was using a different 'share' than the new subsequent transfer
should.

upload of a file to the wrong place. When this happens, the same credentials
are used and the server name is the same.", "title": "CVE description"}], "product_status": {"recommended": ["openSUSE Leap 16.0:curl-8.14.1-160000.9.1.aarch64", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:curl-8.14.1-160000.9.1.ppc64le", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:curl-8.14.1-160000.9.1.s390x", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:curl-8.14.1-160000.9.1.x86_64", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:curl-fish-completion-8.14.1-160000.9.1.noarch", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:curl-zsh-completion-8.14.1-160000.9.1.noarch", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl-devel-8.14.1-160000.9.1.aarch64", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl-devel-8.14.1-160000.9.1.ppc64le", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl-devel-8.14.1-160000.9.1.s390x", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl-devel-8.14.1-160000.9.1.x86_64", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl-devel-doc-8.14.1-160000.9.1.noarch", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl4-8.14.1-160000.9.1.aarch64", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl4-8.14.1-160000.9.1.ppc64le", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl4-8.14.1-160000.9.1.s390x", "openSUSE Leap 16.0:libcurl4-8.14.1-160000.9.1.x86_64"]}, "references": [{"category": "external", "summary": "CVE-2026-5773", "url": "https://www.suse.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-5773"}, {"category": "external", "summary": "SUSE Bug 1262633 for CVE-2026-5773", "url": "https://bugzilla.suse.com/1262633"}], "remediations": [{"category": "vendor_fix", "details": "To install this SUSE Security Update use the SUSE recommended installation methods like YaST online_update or "zypper patch".
